items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Chuck Mangione and his brother Gap? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Chuck Mangione! Chuck Mangione was playing trumpet... Charles had heard Keith in Boston and so we both said 'Oh! Keith, let's get Keith!'

ctx.x: Chuck Mangione and his brother Gap?

Chuck Mangione! Chuck Mangione was playing trumpet. Frank Mitchell was playing tenor saxophone and Keith was playing piano on a song called "Buttercorn Lady.” Charles asked me about a pianist, and Charles had heard Keith in Boston and so we both said "Oh! Keith, let's get Keith!" Then Reggie didn't work out so I'd been playing with Cecil so I suggested Cecil McBee, and then the Charles Lloyd Quartet was formed. So I was still doing some freelancing around New York. I got a chance to play with McCoy and Joe…
